opening.argument: The video pairs Clash of Clans gameplay with a straightforward subscriber milestone promotion: viewers are offered entry into a $10 iTunes gift-card giveaway by subscribing and liking the video. Those are ordinary channel-engagement actions, and the title identifies the promotion as closed rather than presenting an ongoing or concealed opportunity. The speaker also transitions to showing a raid, confirming that the giveaway appears alongside ordinary gameplay rather than replacing it with an unsupported promise of gain.

citations.quote: To thank you all, I am doing a $10 iTunes gift card giveaway! All you have to do is to subscribe and like this video to be entered to win!
